author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Callihan goes yard Sunday
desc: Tyler Callihan went 2-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in the Pirates 9-4 win over the Reds on Sunday.
impact: Callihan capped off a four-run second inning for Pittsburgh with a three-run blast. He is slashing .259/.359/.537 with three home runs and 12 RBI across 64 at-bats.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan O'Hearn goes deep twice Sunday
desc: Ryan O'Hearn went 3-for-5 with two home runs and four RBI in the Pirates 9-4 win over the Reds on Sunday.
impact: O'Hearn broke the game open with a three-run blast in the eighth inning. He previously collected an RBI base hit and went deep off Brady Singer. He is slashing .286/.342/.479 with 13 home runs and 50 RBI on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mitch Keller earns win Sunday
desc: Mitch Keller allowed four runs (three earned) on five hits over six innings with four strikeouts and one walk in a win on Sunday against the Reds.
impact: Keller threw three scoreless innings to start the day before he ran into some trouble. Pittsburgh gave him four runs of support early to help him earn his sixth win of the season. He'll face the Nationals next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ketel Marte goes yard Sunday
desc: Ketel Marte went 1-for-3 with a home run in the Diamondbacks 5-1 loss against the Rays on Sunday.
impact: Marte went deep in the eighth inning for the lone run scored by Arizona on the day. He has now went deep in back-to-back games and three of the last four.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Merrill Kelly takes loss Sunday
desc: Merrill Kelly allowed five runs on eight hits over six innings with three strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Sunday against the Rays.
impact: Kelly served up three home runs in the loss. He will take a 5.84 ERA into his next outing against the Brewers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Manny Machado hits home run Sunday
desc: Manny Machado went 2-for-4 with a home run in the Padres 4-2 loss against the Dodgers on Sunday.
impact: Machado homered and doubled in the loss. He is still hitting just .188 on the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Michael King takes loss Sunday
desc: Michael King allowed four runs on three hits over 4 1/3 innings with five strikeouts and four walks in a loss on Sunday against the Dodgers.
impact: King struggled with his command in a tough matchup. He'll be tough to trust in another matchup against the Dodgers next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Victor Robles steals three bases Sunday
desc: Victor Robles went 2-for-5 with three stolen bags in the Mariners 6-5 loss against the Guardians.
impact: Robles had a sequence where he reached first base on an infield single and stole second and third before he scored on an infield single hit by Julio Rodriguez. He remains off the fantasy radar in his platoon role.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock bounces back Sunday
desc: Emerson Hancock allowed one run on five hits over 5 2/3 innings with six strikeouts and three walks in a no-decision on Sunday against the Guardians.
impact: After allowing 11 runs in his previous two starts, Hancock settled in nicely on Sunday. He left the game with the lead, but the Mariners bullpen blew the lead in the eighth inning. He'll face the Blue Jays next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Drew Bowser promoted to Double-A
desc: The Chicago Cubs are promoting 3B Drew Bowser to Double-A Knoxville.
impact: Bowser is coming off a strong month of June with High-A South Bend.  He will look to continue his success at the plate into Double-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jack O'Dowd promoted to Double-A
desc: The Colorado Rockies are promoting C/1B Jack O'Dowd to Double-A Hartford.
impact: O'Dowd hit .359 with 20 extra-base hits and 38 RBI for High-A Spokane. He will look to continue his success at the plate into Double-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Carlos Sanchez promoted to Double-A
